summary: Manual agent suspension now preserves native sessions in non-Git workspaces in place, just like idle suspension. Resume retains the original transcript and refuses recorded Git/non-Git workspace-kind changes.

replay.detail: No claim replay required. Existing suspension records remain readable.

schema.detail: No client-v0 or claim schema change. Host-local snapshot manifests add a defaulted workspace_kind field; capture markers persist the kind atomically.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rule or coordinated fleet rules change.

compatibility.detail: Git snapshots without workspace_kind default to Git. Historical in-place snapshots and empty capture markers convert to legacy-unknown, preserving their previous resume behavior and recording legacy-unknown-kind resume evidence. Known kinds enforce equality at resume. Older in-place-capable daemons ignore the added field and do not enforce the equality guard; use an updated daemon for resume. Older daemons without in-place support cannot restore the absent Git bundle and refuse. Non-Git sessions remain source-host-only; arbitrary workspace files are not archived.

downtime.detail: Applies with the next normal daemon deployment; no live agent action is required.

manual.detail: No migration or operator step required; suspended sessions are not modified.

recovery.detail: Reverting restores manual non-Git refusal. Keep an in-place-capable daemon available for existing non-Git suspensions; older compatible readers preserve the original transcript but lack workspace-kind validation.
